purpose: Explain and audit public-release data safety risk before exporting or pushing the public js-reverse-ops skill.

risk_classes.label: Secrets and tokens
risk_classes.rationale: Bearer tokens, API keys, cloud keys, private keys, and JWT-like values must never be published in public reverse-engineering packages.
risk_classes.recommended_action: Remove the value, rotate the credential if it was real, and replace examples with synthetic placeholders.

risk_classes.label: Private hosts or case names
risk_classes.rationale: Named challenge hosts, private endpoints, and case-specific URLs can disclose customer, target, or research context.
risk_classes.recommended_action: Generalize the host, route, and case name before export; keep concrete target notes in a private workspace.

risk_classes.label: Local filesystem paths
risk_classes.rationale: Absolute local paths reveal usernames, workstation layout, and private workspace names.
risk_classes.recommended_action: Replace absolute paths with repo-relative paths or placeholders.

risk_classes.label: Raw capture artifacts
risk_classes.rationale: HAR, PCAP, and raw capture files often contain cookies, headers, IPs, and request bodies.
risk_classes.recommended_action: Do not publish raw captures. Publish redacted summaries or synthetic examples only.

risk_classes.label: Generated artifacts
risk_classes.rationale: Generated runs, caches, dist output, and temporary files are easy places for private evidence to accumulate.
risk_classes.recommended_action: Keep generated artifacts ignored and untracked; rebuild them locally when needed.

risk_classes.label: Dependency and install artifacts
risk_classes.rationale: Vendored installs and lockstep cache output bloat the public package and may carry environment-specific files.
risk_classes.recommended_action: Remove install artifacts and document reproducible installation instead.

risk_classes.label: Suspicious fixture names
risk_classes.rationale: Fixture names that imply real users, customers, or private cases deserve manual review before public release.
risk_classes.recommended_action: Rename fixtures to synthetic sample names and remove any target-specific values.

ignored_artifact_policy.action: Allowed locally when ignored, but must not be tracked or copied into the public export.
